ev.q: Analyses compared changes in the crude rate of fentanyl submissions, fentanyl prescriptions, and synthetic opioid deaths during 2013–2014 using Pearson correlations.
Changes in synthetic opioid–involved overdose deaths among 27 states were highly correlated with fentanyl submissions
the synthetic opioid crude death rate in the eight high-burden states increased 174%, from 1.3 to 3.6 per 100,000
synthetic opioid deaths increased by 79%, from 3,105 in 2013 to 5,544 in 2014
Changes in fentanyl submissions and synthetic opioid death rates from 2013–2014 among the 27 states were highly correlated (r = 0.95)
Among high-burden states, all demographic groups experienced substantial increases in synthetic opioid death rates.

methods_quotes.q: Analyses compared changes in the crude rate of fentanyl submissions, fentanyl prescriptions, and synthetic opioid deaths during 2013–2014 using Pearson correlations.
States were classified as high-burden if they experienced a 1-year increase in synthetic opioid deaths exceeding two per 100,000 residents
Gamma tests were used if cell count was less than 100 in 2013 or 2014
z-tests were used if cell counts were ≥100 in both 2013 and 2014
Cells with nine or fewer deaths are not reported and rates based on <20 deaths are not considered reliable and not reported.
